_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 70 12h windows producing a ±2pt move, this is a textbook coil where forced directional calls have gone 0-for-18 — HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until a breaker confirms.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the narrative writer implies a forthcoming UP move toward Hope/Optimism while the analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; I side with the analyst and the base-rate data.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows recover above 30 with funding dropping below 40 within 48h (institutional bid returns) OR fear_greed drops below 20 with mvrv_zscore below 15 (true flush toward Panic/Capitulation)
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows remain < 10 AND btc_momentum_30d drops below 40 while vix stays > 55 (confirms rollover into Anxiety, would force phase shift and REDUCE signal)
